topic: Principles of Holography and Diffraction: Capturing Light in 3D

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Wave Nature of Light
lecture_lines: Light behaves as a propagating wave.
Waves possess both crests and troughs.
animations: Create a point light source using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lightbulb.svg] emitting coherent waves. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Show spherical wavefronts propagating outward from the light source [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lightbulb.svg]. (Color: #FFFF00)
Demonstrate light waves from [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lightbulb.svg] interacting with an object. (Color: #00FF00)

sections.title: The Physics of Diffraction
lecture_lines: Apertures cause waves to spread out.
animations: Introduce a narrow slit using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/slit.svg] causing wave bending. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Display Huygens-Fresnel principle for wavefront propagation. (Color: #00FFFF)
Illustrate the resulting diffraction pattern on [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/screen.svg]. (Color: #FF00FF)

sections.title: Holography: Recording the Wavefront
animations: Overlay reference beam with object light beam using laser [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/laser.svg]. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Display resulting interference pattern on the medium. (Color: #FF0000)
Capture the interference fringes on holographic plate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plate.svg]. (Color: #00FF00)

sections.title: Reconstruction: The Diffraction Reversal
animations: Illuminate the hologram [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hologram.svg] with the reference beam [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/laser.svg]. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Show the wavefront being reconstructed from fringes. (Color: #FFFF00)
Demonstrate the creation of the virtual image [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hologram.svg]. (Color: #00FFFF)
